snippet.title: Two Winds | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Ride the wind to the meadow. Two Winds is a gentle puzzle game for all ages: guide hot air balloons along wind currents, catch thermals, slip past drifting clouds, chasing storms and eagles, and land every balloon on its own meadow before sunset.

120 levels in six valleys and a new flight every day.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821148614
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jlianes.twowinds

Lianes8 Studio: https://lianes8studio.com/two-winds
